PingCentral does not use golang. Multiple git submodules are present in the PingCentral image’s Alpine OS. As these are written in golang, the packages contain go files as dependencies, however no go commands are executable on PingCentral, meaning that even with local access to a container, vulnerabilities in go language components cannot be exploited. If the case arises that a vulnerability in go can be exploited in an Alpine package, we would act on this and patch accordingly.

Not affected. CVE-2026-111497 is an out-of-bounds write in the Node.js built-in Brotli decoder, exploitable only where a Node.js runtime decompresses attacker-controlled Brotli data. PingCentral does not ship or execute a Node.js runtime: the Node.js-built UI is compiled ahead of time into static JavaScript bundles served by the product, and at request time the browser (not Node.js) renders it and performs any Content-Encoding decompression using the browser's own Brotli implementation, which is separate code and not affected by this CVE. Node.js is used only in CI build containers, which are not deployed to production.
